packages.name: Shelly Plug US Gen4 (Zigbee)
packages.description: Driver for the Shelly Plug US Gen4 (S4PL-00116US) in Zigbee mode: switch, power, energy, voltage, current and frequency in the plug's own units, trip detection, and the plug's settings from Hubitat (power-on state, overpower cutoff, auto-off timer, current and voltage limits, LED ring, Bluetooth, Wi-Fi).
